mood: Setting: an old Damascus-style stone alley at night, ivory stone arches covered in climbing pink and peach roses and jasmine, antique wrought-iron street lamps with warm golden glow, hanging brass lanterns, fireflies and floating rose petals sparkling in the air, VERY vivid saturated rich colours: glowing amber gold, rose pink, deep crimson, emerald-teal night shadows, violet sky with stars, dreamy bokeh, cinematic romantic atmosphere, intricate beautiful details.
scenes: Magical wide establishing shot from above: the long stone stairway winding through the rose-covered alley at night, glowing lamps and lanterns, the two of them small, sitting together on the steps half way up, a crescent moon and stars over the domes.

Medium shot: they sit side by side on the old stone steps under a glowing lamp, she rests her cheek on her hand and smiles at him dreamily, he smiles back, roses cascading above them, fireflies around.

Close-up: she looks hurt and turns her face a little away, eyes glistening, holding a single red rose to her chest; he looks at her regretfully, warm lamp light on one side, cool teal shadow on the other, petals falling.

Close-up: they sit on the old stone step, she gently holds his hand with both of hers and looks up at him pleading tenderly, he softens and smiles, glowing petals and tiny golden fireflies around their hands.

She stands alone at an arched wooden window with stained glass in the old house at night, a lantern beside her, holding a handwritten letter to her chest, longing, looking out at the rose alley; moonlight and golden candle glow.

Dreamy surreal shot: she lies on a carpet of rose petals on the rooftop at night looking up at the starry sky, eyes half closed thinking of him, and his smiling face is softly painted in the glowing clouds and stars above her, fireflies.
He comes up the glowing stone stairway holding a big bouquet of red roses, she runs down the steps toward him, her braid flying, lamps glowing, petals swirling around them.

Final magical shot: they embrace tightly under the old street lamp at the top of the rose stairway, foreheads touching, eyes closed, a storm of glowing rose petals and fireflies spiralling around them, the moon huge behind them.
